qualifications: Whole analytic/NURBS/polyline/polycurve rails, explicit surface and box Brep edge routes, both command kinds and source currentness guards
Turns/Pitch from full rail length, reverse twist, fractional turns, default and numeric density, radius locks and diameter conversion
Swept span counts floor(abs(turns)*points_per_turn) with a minimum of three; closed rails interpolate the first N stations periodically, including fractional twists and tapered radii
Linear cyclic interpolation checked against the independent pivoted dense solver across sizes and scales, plus a 10000-station periodic solve
CPlane-relative radius coordinates use the appropriate station or Flat center; whole and edge sources retain original geometry storage through actual Undo/Redo
Source selection at the native EndCommand boundary and through Undo/Redo; selected input requires a new explicit pick in AroundCurve
Flat equal-radius input fails without output, with an atomic local retry
metric_policy: Thirty-one distinct successful workflows compare full geometry/history within absolute 1e-6. The closed spatial workflow is a named diagnostic: topology, counts, degree, knots and source/history behavior match, but maximum Euclidean control distance is about 1.97e-6. It is bounded at 3e-6 and is not a 1e-6 qualification. The SDK and interactive native curves for that input are identical. The earlier four large axial endpoint-control limits remain in spiral-validation.json.
source_selection_policy: The native EndCommand snapshot retains whole input selection. The private Pause/SelID macro unwinds with the whole source unselected in after_script; its geometry is identical. Local command snapshots compare EndCommand, Undo and Redo. Macro-unwind selection is not claimed as UI parity.

native_capture_provenance.purpose: Twenty-three attempted rail workflows; 21 clean initial results. The two timed-out input rows were replaced and the surface-edge row was recaptured with selection receipts.

Three complete managed getter recaptures for explicit preselection picking, separate numeric density and physically acknowledged surface-edge selection; merged into the main profile and retained separately.
Physically acknowledged box edge, closed polyline and closed spatial rail.
Three rail-relative radius inputs, including a rotated CPlane and an independently established prior point.
Axial second-radius relative input and native equal-radius Flat failure.
Two successful nonconstant Flat radius relative-coordinate inputs.
Independent public SDK swept constructor and precise closed-rail station output; SDK curve equals interactive native control data exactly.

unqualified: Exhaustive mouse/snap/ambiguity behavior and rail families or parameter ranges outside the fixtures
Native preference retention on cancellation and deterministic Enter directions without pointer receipts
Performance parity with Rhino; the cyclic solver has linear complexity and a 10000-point correctness check, not a native timing benchmark
The four earlier large axial endpoint-control limits in spiral-validation.json
